decisions.reason: As an incremental extension with unresolved demand uncertainty and low keeping cost, the real option remains open.
Its dedicated page indicates ongoing commitment and information gathering, and with no negative signals the option is kept open at low cost.
The product builds on established technology and still has high uncertainty, so the low cost of keeping it justifies holding the option.
The dedicated page and fit with established systems suggest a valuable option, and without evidence of failure it is kept open.
